title: ACE2 chromogenic immunostaining protocol optimized for formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded human tissue sections
protocol: Remove paraffin from FFPE sections.
Melt paraffin to drive off any residual water trapped behind sections.
Place slides in a xylene compatible, non-metal slide rack.
Bake the rack of slides in a 55°C dry oven for one hour.
Dissolve surrounding and infiltrating paraffin from the sections.
Place rack of slides in xylene for 5 min.
Transfer rack of slides to fresh xylene, incubate for 5 min.
Transfer slides to fresh xylene, incubate for 5 min.
Clear the xylene from slides.
Place rack of slides in 100% ethanol for 5 min.
Transfer rack of slides to fresh 100% ethanol, and incubate for 5 min.
Block endogenous peroxidases by placing the rack of slides in freshly prepared 3% hydrogen peroxide diluted in methanol, and incubate for 10 min at room temperature (20°C–22°C).
Rehydrate sections through graded ethanol solutions.
Transfer slide rack to 95% ethanol and incubate for 5 min.
Transfer slide rack to 75% ethanol and incubate for 5 min.
Transfer slide rack to 50% ethanol and incubate for 5 min.
Transfer slide rack through two changes of deionized (DI) water for 2 min each.
Prepare 1× citrate buffer by diluting 1 part of 10× citrate buffer stock solution with 9 parts deionized water.
Transfer slides to a plastic coplin jar filled with 1× citrate buffer.
Place coplin jar into a 400 mL Pyrex beaker and fill the beaker with tap water up to one cm from the cap edge.
Program a microwave oven at 600 watts for 7 minutes.
Place the coplin/water jacket assembly in the center of the microwave and start the program.
Allow the coplin/water jacket assembly to cool on the bench top for 20 minutes after the microwave cycle ends.
Incubate slides for 1 minute in DI water to rinse off buffer.
Make a hydrophobic barrier around the tissue section using PAP pen.
Place slides in a prepared humid staining chamber and cover the section surface with wash buffer.
Block biotin present in the tissue using Avidin/Biotin blocking kit (Vector Laboratories).
Wipe buffer from the surface of the slide with a folded Kimwipe, avoiding contact with the tissue.
Cover tissue section surface with biotin solution and incubate 15 min.
Wash slides in wash buffer for 5 min.
Wipe buffer from the surface of the slide with a folded Kimwipe, avoiding contact with the tissue.
Cover tissue section surface with avidin solution and incubate for 15 min.
Wash slides in buffer for 5 min.
Wipe buffer from the surface of the slide with a folded Kimwipe, avoiding contact with the tissue.
Perform normal goat serum blocking if biotin blocking is not necessary for your tissue type.
Cover the tissue section surface with goat serum diluted to 2% in wash buffer and incubate 30 min at room temperature (20°C–22°C).
Wipe serum from the surface of the slide with a folded Kimwipe, avoiding contact with the tissue.
Dilute rabbit monoclonal ACE2 primary antibody at 1:150 in antibody diluent reagent.
Cover tissue section-containing area of slide with ACE2 antibody solution.
Incubate for 1 h.
Dilute biotinylated secondary antibody to 1:200 in wash buffer.
Wash slides in wash buffer for 5 min.
Wipe buffer from the surface of the slide with a folded Kimwipe, avoiding contact with the tissue.
Cover tissue section with biotinylated secondary antibody solution, and incubate for 30 min.
Wash slides in wash buffer for 5 min.
Wipe buffer from the surface of the slide with a folded Kimwipe, avoiding contact with the tissue.
Cover tissue section in prepared ABC Elite reagent and incubate for 30 min.
Wash slides in wash buffer for 5 min.
Prepare DAB immediately prior to use.
Detect primary antibody signal using DAB.
Counterstain section with hematoxylin.
Prepare working solution of DAB following kit instructions.
Combine one drop of DAB stock with one mL of DAB diluent.
Wipe buffer from the surface of one slide with a folded Kimwipe, avoiding contact with the tissue.
Cover surface of section in DAB solution.
Start a count-up timer.
Monitor brown color development under a brightfield microscope.
Stop the reaction by submerging the slide in water and rinsing with mild agitation when signal reaches desired intensity.
Place completed slide in a slide rack.
Repeat development steps for all remaining slides.
Develop Rabbit IgG isotype control slides for the same amount of time as ACE2 slide development.
Counterstain slides with hematoxylin.
Place slide rack in tap water for 5 min to hydrate.
Transfer slide rack to hematoxylin for 15 s.
Wash in rapid changes of tap water until color ceases to drain from slides.
Incubate rack of slides in Clarifier solution for 20 s.
Wash rack of slides 2 × 1 min in tap water.
Incubate rack of slides 1 min in Bluing solution.
Wash rack of slides 2 × 1 min in tap water.
Dehydrate slides in graded ethanol solutions.
Place rack of slides in 50% ethanol for 2 min.
Transfer rack of slides to 75% ethanol for 2 min.
Transfer rack of slides to 95% ethanol for 2 min.
Transfer rack of slides to 100% ethanol for 2 min.
Incubate rack of slides for 5 min in 100% ethanol.
Place the slides twice in xylene for 5 minutes each.
Mount glass coverslips to the slides with Shandon-Mount mounting media.
Let the slides dry for at least 1 hour.
Scan stained slides and view digitized images using an Aperio CS2 slide scanner system.
